name: Tem um Incêndio na Minha Casa
source:
Your name is Ignis.

You're a hard worker by day and a schoolgirl by night.

Tiredness, a lack of time, and your ability to forget to respond to messages has been pushing you away from everything and everyone, little by little, except for two individuals: your cat and your best friend, Angie.

As if that wasn't enough, some unusual events begin to manifest in your home: faceless shadows, out of place objects, and noises in the middle of the night.

Some things can't be avoided, but small choices can make all the difference.

Have fun :)

[Translated from [url=https://aquanirae.itch.io/tem-um-incendio-na-minha-casa]itch.io[/url]]
